executed_checks.command:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import TemporaryDirectory
import shutil, subprocess, re, sys
for case in ('baseline','extra-effect','extra-condition','missing-not-cast'):
    with TemporaryDirectory() as d:
        root=Path(d)
        for name in ('Shares','Organisation','Notes','Guardians','Friendship','Knowledge'):
            shutil.copytree(Path('contracts')/name,root/name)
        p=root/'Shares'/'full-schemas.txt'
        before=p.read_text()
        pattern=r'^.*■ Vote of Alice for Issue:.*$'
        def edit(m):
            s=m.group(0)
            if case=='extra-effect': return s.replace(' <-', ', shelf(Alice,Voter) <-')
            if case=='extra-condition': return s.replace(' guarded by', ', shelf(Alice,Voter) guarded by')
            if case=='missing-not-cast': return re.sub(r', ~vote_issue_alice\([^)]*\)', '', s)
            return s
        adjusted,n=re.subn(pattern,edit,before,flags=re.M)
        assert n==1 and (adjusted==before)==(case=='baseline')
        p.write_text(adjusted)
        run=subprocess.run([sys.executable,'tools/derive.py','Shares','--root',d],capture_output=True,text=True)
        print(case,run.returncode)
        print(run.stdout,end='')
        print(run.stderr,end='')
